description: This file defines the ADODB2_access class, a PHP class that extends ADODB_DataDict to provide database schema abstraction specifically for Microsoft Access databases. It includes methods for data type mapping, SQL statement construction, and database schema operations.

classes.name: ADODB2_access
classes.description: A PHP class for managing Access database schema operations, extending ADODB_DataDict.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps metadata codes to corresponding database data types.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffixes for column creation based on field attributes.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Stub method for creating a database, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: SetSchema
methods.description: Stub method for setting the schema, currently does nothing.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method for altering columns, not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method for dropping columns, not supported in this implementation.
